# 1.2.33 - the brush is a brush, a stamp is ink, the dice are cut

Three of the audit page's drawings that the module had only approximated.

**The brush.** Everything you click wears a rectangle of the state colour
behind its label. It was a fixed polygon, the same eight points on every
control; it is a displacement map now, the audit page's own (`feTurbulence`
into `feDisplacementMap`, scale 16), so the edge is torn and no two brushes
are alike. The polygon stays underneath as the shape the filter tears from,
and is what a player with the glass effects off still gets.

**The stamps.** The Ultimate on the sheet and the typed plates on a Truth
Bullet's card (Key, Preparation, Incident, Resolution) are blots of ink in
the meaning's colour with the letters in ink, blown out by the second filter
(scale 34) over a solid heart so the plate always has something under the
letters.

**The dice.** The module's roll card prints the Hope die and the Despair die;
they are two cut dice now, 54 px, the Hope one in the state colour and the
Despair one in the Eclipse's violet, the total in the title face and the
verdict tracked out beneath them - the audit page's roll window, on the card
the module already has.

Both filters live in one hidden `<svg>` that `chrome.mjs` puts in the body
once. Rendered and read back before release: the hovered brush at 45 %, the
chosen one full, the pressed one dimmed; the stamps blotted; the faces in ink.
